visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot features a white plate holding sliced grilled pork topped with a bright orange raw egg yolk. A person's hand uses black chopsticks to break the yolk, while a yellow bowl of eggs sits in the background on a marble countertop. White text appears at the bottom. (2) An Asian man with short black hair, wearing a black long-sleeved shirt, takes a bite of the pork and reacts with an exaggerated expression of delight. Smoke rises from the food as colorful variety-show style text bubbles pop up. (3) The man holds a plastic-wrapped tray of raw pork from Costco in a brightly lit kitchen setting. He gestures towards the camera while speaking. (4) Hands are shown cutting a large slab of raw pink pork on a wooden board, then sprinkling various powders (garlic and cumin) over the meat. Yellow and red captions identify the seasoning types. (5) A knife is used to poke holes into the seasoned meat on a white square plate. The lighting is bright and even. (6) The meat is placed into a white KINYO air fryer drawer using metal tongs. The drawer is pushed into the machine, and the digital display on the black top panel is set to 200 degrees. (7) Through a transparent window on the air fryer, the pork is visible cooking under a heating element. (8) The cooked pork is sliced on a plate and topped with another yolk. The man and a woman in a white t-shirt are shown eating and reacting positively, with heart-shaped emojis appearing. (9) The man demonstrates cleaning the air fryer basket in a kitchen sink. He pours out dirty water, wipes the interior with a yellow sponge, and rinses it under a running tap. (10) The man stands in a living room wearing a white sweatshirt with a graphic, pointing at the air fryer and various digital infographics showing certificates and product features like the 6.5L capacity and AI touch panel.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male voice introduces the recipe over a driving electronic synth beat with heavy percussion. The vocal pitch is high with dramatic rising intonation. (2) SFX: A sharp metallic 'clink' of chopsticks followed by a 'squelch' sound as the yolk breaks. BGM maintains a steady 128 BPM. (3) Vocal shift to a conversational but loud narrative style. SFX: Low-frequency 'thud' as meat hits the board, followed by high-frequency 'rustling' of seasoning powders being sprinkled. (4) SFX: A percussive 'click-clack' as the air fryer drawer slides shut, immediately followed by a digital 'beep' sound. (5) BGM swells slightly during a montage of cooking. Ambient sound of running water starts abruptly as the cleaning section begins, creating a broad frequency noise floor. (6) SFX: Repetitive 'splash' and 'whoosh' sounds synced with the pouring of water and transitions. Female laughter and enthusiastic shouting 'Wah!' are layered in the mix. (7) Final phase features a rapid-fire sales pitch with compressed, high-arousal male vocals. SFX: Several 'pop' and 'ding' effects accentuate feature mentions. BGM remains consistent until a hard cut at the end.
